arxiv-2004-12170.title: Revisiting Sequence-to-Sequence Video Object Segmentation with Multi-Task Loss and Skip-Memory

arxiv-2004-12170.description: Abstract Video Object Segmentation (VOS) is an active research area of the visual domain. One of its fundamental sub-tasks is semi-supervised / one-shot learning: given only the segmentation mask for the first frame, the task is to provide pixel-accurate masks for the object over the rest of the sequence.

Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have found many applications in tasks involving two-dimensional (2D) data, such as image classification and image processing. To make the system non-Hermitian, we use a traveling field directly interacting with magnons generating gain to the system.

We argue that this is because they ignored (1) the hardware constraints of public cloud NICs (vNICs) and (2) the flexibility required by applications. arxiv-2504-08671.title: Regularized Infill Criteria for Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization with Application to Aircraft Design
arxiv-2504-08671.creator: J.H. Bussemaker
arxiv-2504-08671.description: Abstract Bayesian optimization is an advanced tool to perform efficient global optimization. It consists on enriching iteratively surrogate Kriging models of the objective and the constraints (both supposed to be computationally expensive) of the targeted optimization problem. Nowadays, efficient extensions of Bayesian optimization to solve expensive multi-objective problems are of high interest.

arxiv-2510-21624.title: Five-loop beta function for gauge theories: computations, results and consequences Speaker at the 2025 International Conference of Basic Science, presenting the article [ 1 ] which received a 2025 Frontier of Science Award in Theoretical Physics.
arxiv-2510-21624.description: Abstract At the end of 2016, we computed the five-loop (N 4 LO) contributions to the beta function in perturbative Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD), its generalization to non-Abelian gauge theories with a simple compact Lie group, and for Quantum Electrodynamics (QED). Here we recall main tools used in and specifically developed for this computation and its main analytic and numerical results.

arxiv-2511-14427.title: Self-Supervised Multisensory Pretraining for Contact-Rich Robot Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2511-14427.creator: Rickmer Krohn, Vignesh Prasad, Gabriele Tiboni, Georgia Chalvatzaki
arxiv-2511-14427.description: Abstract Effective contact-rich manipulation requires robots to synergistically leverage vision, force, and proprioception. However, Reinforcement Learning agents struggle to learn in such multisensory settings, especially amidst sensory noise and dynamic changes. We propose MultiSensory Dynamic Pretraining (MSDP), a novel framework for learning expressive multisensory representations tailored for task-oriented policy learning.

pmc-10710739.description: China” published in the journal Infection and Drug Resistance. pmc-10768408.title: 5-methoxytryptophan induced apoptosis and PI3K/Akt/FoxO3a phosphorylation in colorectal cancer
pmc-10768408.creator: Tian-Lei Zhao, Yue Qi, Yi-Fan Wang, Yi Wang, Hui Liang, Ya-Bin Pu
pmc-10768408.description: BACKGROUNDColorectal cancer (CRC) is a highly prevalent malignancy worldwide, and new therapeutic targets urgently need to be found to prolong patient survival. 5-methoxytryptophan (5-MTP) is a tryptophan metabolite found in animals and humans. However, the effects of 5-MTP on proliferation and apoptosis of CRC cells are currently unknown.

pmc-11263061.title: Severe acute pancreatitis complicated with intra-abdominal infection secondary to trauma: A case report
pmc-11263061.creator: Yu Zhang, Yun-Feng Cui
pmc-11263061.description: BACKGROUNDPancreatic trauma (PT) is rare among traumatic injuries and has a low incidence, but it can still lead to severe infectious complications, resulting in a high mortality rate. Acute pancreatitis (AP) is a common complication after PT, and when combined with organ dysfunction and sepsis, it will result in a poorer prognosis.

pmc-11543145.title: Need for neurorehabilitation in the Middle East and North Africa from 1990 to 2021: an analysis based on the global burden of disease study

pmc-11554835.title: The role of mitochondria in tumor metastasis and advances in mitochondria-targeted cancer therapy
pmc-11554835.creator: Fanglu Chen, Yucheng Xue, Wenkan Zhang, Hao Zhou, Zhiyi Zhou, Tao Chen, Eloy YinWang, Hengyuan Li, Zhaoming Ye, Junjie Gao, Shengdong Wang
pmc-11554835.description: Mitochondria are central actors in diverse physiological phenomena ranging from energy metabolism to stress signaling and immune modulation. Accumulating scientific evidence points to the critical involvement of specific mitochondrial-associated events, including mitochondrial quality control, intercellular mitochondrial transfer, and mitochondrial genetics, in potentiating the metastatic cascade of neoplastic cells.

pmc-11649533.title: Directly observed social contact patterns among school children in rural Gambia
pmc-11649533.creator: Isaac Osei, Emmanuel Mendy, Kevin van Zandvoort, Olimatou Jobe, Golam Sarwar, Baleng Mahama Wutor, Stefan Flasche, Nuredin I Mohammed, Jane Bruce, Brian Greenwood, Grant A Mackenzie
pmc-11649533.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionSchool-aged children play a major role in the transmission of many respiratory pathogens due to high rate of close contacts in schools. The validity and accuracy of proxy-reported contact data may be limited, particularly for children when attending school. We observed social contacts within schools and assessed the accuracy of proxy-reported versus observed physical contact data among students in rural Gambia.MethodsWe enrolled school children who had also been recruited to a survey of Streptococcus pneumoniae carriage and social contacts.

pmc-12561793.title: Diversity of Menstrual Cycle, Formation of Decidual Cells, and Lack of Endometrial Glands in Spiny Mouse
pmc-12561793.creator: Roman Eremichev, Nina Nikolaeva, Mikhail Khandokhin, Roman Tsvetcov, Natalya Alexandrushkina, Alena Shilova, Vladimir Popov, Pavel Makarevich, Paul S Cooke
pmc-12561793.description: Simple SummaryModels of endometrium turnover via menstrual cycle are limited and recent discovery of Acomys genus spiny mouse that possesses this physiological feature provided a valuable tool for researchers. In our spiny mice colony we failed to detect typical mensutral bleeding while we encountered decidual cells and lack of endometrial glands which contrasted to CD1 laboratory mice.

pmc-12578434.title: Moringa oleifera Supplementation for Reducing Heavy Metal Toxicity and Oxidative Stress in Pregnant Women: Protocol for a Nonrandomized Trial Study
pmc-12578434.creator: Hasnawati Amqam, Anna Khuzaimah, Ulfah Najamuddin, Mardiana Ahmad, Muflihatul Muniroh, Ancah Caesarina Novi Marchianti, Saliza Mohd Elias
pmc-12578434.description: BackgroundHeavy metals present in the environment, including lead, cadmium, and mercury, pose significant health risks to pregnant women and fetal development through food, water, and air contamination. Exposure to these metals has been linked to miscarriage, low birth weight (LBW), preterm birth, and developmental issues in children.

pmc-12586574.title: Heterogeneity in an adeno-associated virus transfection-based production process limits the production efficiency
pmc-12586574.creator: Brian Ladd, Sofia Tunmats, Torbjörn Gräslund, Olalekan Daramola, Johan Rockberg, Véronique Chotteau
pmc-12586574.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The popularity of rAAV vectors in gene therapy are placing a burden on current production systems. To improve the accessibility of these life changing treatments, increases in production yields and a reduction in the cost-of-goods are needed. Transient transfection is the most common way to introduce rAAV-encoding plasmids to producer cells but it suffers from significant drawbacks such as low and inconsistent yields as well as high cost due to its need for plasmid DNA.

pmc-12996661.title: Developing Synthetic Orthopantomogram Datasets Through Generative Models
pmc-12996661.creator: Niha Adnan, Syed Muhammad Faizan Ahmed, Fahad Umer
pmc-12996661.description: ObjectiveTo generate synthetic Orthopantomograms (OPGs) using generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) models and to evaluate the realism of synthetic images through assessments by humans as well as AI models.MethodologyThis study conducted at Aga Khan University Hospital (AKUH) aimed to generate synthetic OPGs using anonymized images from the existing database at AKUH dental clinics.

pmc-13445667.title: Braining, structured physical activity in specialized psychiatry for patients with substance use disorders—a feasibility study
pmc-13445667.creator: Åsa Anger, Leida Kaaman, Rebecka Mac, Johan Holmberg, Nitya Jayaram-Lindström, Tobias Lundgren, Maria Hagströmer, Carl Johan Sundberg, Lina Martinsson, Sigrid Salomonsson
pmc-13445667.description: BackgroundIndividuals with substance use disorders (SUD) have poor metabolic and cardiovascular health and a high prevalence of depression and anxiety symptoms. Regular physical activity can improve both somatic and mental health. This study aimed to evaluate the feasibility of an aerobic physical activity intervention (Braining) in psychiatric care services specialized in SUD.

pmc-13546225.title: Examining the Role of Natural Mentors in the Relationship Between Childhood Abuse, Life Satisfaction, and Depression: Findings from Add Health
pmc-13546225.creator: Savannah B. Simpson, Bailey R. Dow, Samuel D. McQuillin
pmc-13546225.description: The current study investigated the impact of childhood abuse (i.e., physical abuse, sexual abuse, and neglect) on life satisfaction and depression in adulthood, while also examining the role of natural mentors. Natural mentors are nonparental adults from one’s social network (e.g., teachers, coaches, extended family, community members) who provide guidance and support.

pmc-13551276.title: Optimizing Perioperative Management of Haemophilia B With rFIX‐FP: Pharmacokinetic Validation of the Hemoptidose Tool
pmc-13551276.creator: Xavier Delavenne, Célia Vollard, Nicolas Drillaud, Sabine Castet, Nicolas Luyck, Emilie Hénin, Julien Denis‐Le Seve, Fabienne Volot, Brigitte Tardy, Stéphanie Désage, Benoît Guillet
pmc-13551276.description: BackgroundSurgical management of haemophilia B requires precise factor IX replacement to ensure adequate haemostasis while optimizing factor consumption. Extended half‐life rFIX‐FP simplifies perioperative management but exhibits substantial pharmacokinetic variability. PK‐guided dosing is recommended by WFH guidelines, yet validated tools for perioperative rFIX‐FP individualization are lacking.

pmc-13572820.title: Bridging the Knowledge–Practice Gap in Breast Cancer Awareness: A Nationwide Online Cross‐Sectional KAP Study Among Adult Females in Nigeria
pmc-13572820.creator: Madinat Hassan, Taofeek Tope Adegboyega, Bilkisu Usman Farouk, Sunday Zeal Bala, Rachael Olufunmilayo Oduyemi, Kazeem Owolabi, Munir Sani, Miracle Uwa Livinus, Hannatu Usman Ayuba, Sadiq Hassan, Ifeyinwa Maureen Okeke, Abednego Shekari, Murtala Jibril
pmc-13572820.description: Background and AimsBreast cancer (BCa) is a major cause of cancer morbidity and mortality among women in Nigeria, with late presentation contributing to poor outcomes. This study assessed knowledge, attitudes, and willingness to perform breast self‐examination (BSE) among adult females in Nigeria and examined associated factors.MethodsWe conducted a descriptive cross‐sectional online survey between February 16 and April 30, 2024.
